title: Bind emitted k8 helper 450 to the retained Lean wrapper pair
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This finite audit connects helper **450** in the selected seven-slot k8 word to the retained Lean `pair3` wrapper identity. It checks the actual emitted pre/post positions and frame path, exact scalar restoration and isolation, and both regenerated wrapper monomials. Only `research/k8-hpe450-binding/` is added.

Both local orientations have 24,767 events and 19,693 scalar operations. Independent exact rational propagation gives a unit output row and isolated input column for helper 450, including the eight private center coordinates. The recipe `2:999` equals Lean `pair3`, including both global phases. Its pre/post wrappers occur at zero-based positions 7,852 and 24,562; its four frame increments are 2, 3, 1, 1.

This is a **partial theorem-to-emission binding**, with no new Lean theorem, supplier admission or kappa claim. Exact lowering of other events, a formal JSON-to-Lean correspondence, physical hosting/footprints, all-size compilation, precision/tape, full costs and analytic transfer remain separate. No fresh Lean build or full selected cold replay was run.

## Task and overlap

- Task `formal-interface-lemma`, refined to `k8-seven-slot/raw-helper450/pair3/emitted-boundary`. Selector nonce `7fff7b3cd0d148756c5fc7685585eb0a`; full card in `TASK.json`.
- Started from current main `ebedc0895eb4c06725af020bc1af165722b0a3ce`; rebased onto `81e81af67714bdc8d1693b0bf5c29468b92f62ff`. Revision-3 guidance was reread: this card, all live inputs and the selected result were unchanged.
- Contribution head: `156cc788b5a8122b19686f015e5654b117e4389d`.
- Raw word content: `c2b294300760e1fd6eeab8c22c4d13e4633dca40e52cac8da0d68163a76e3ca8`. The selected source manifest binds the slot pins; fresh canonical and forward/backward event payloads match those pins.
- [PR1415](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1415), head `0d8d2c3a96346756f02563b401a042ab97198e20`, already audits the fixed operator kernels. This addresses its explicit emitted-helper follow-up. No pending PR implementation is imported or executed.
- [Claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1394#discussioncomment-18914238). Submission overlap refresh at 03:54 UTC covered 733 open PRs and 244 discussion records, complete pagination and no warnings. Matches were the predecessor and this investigation; this is not a novelty guarantee.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/k8-hpe450-binding
python3 -B scripts/verify_selected_result.py
```

Registered replay passes on CPython 3.12.13/macOS. The direct replay also passes on CPython 3.14.6. All 28 semantic mutations are rejected **without checksum guards**. One control preserves the helper row but leaks its dirt elsewhere: coefficient 1/2 at L230 forward and 1 at L27 backward, rejected by the column check.

Five tests cover a separate dense-matrix oracle on all 512 three-operation words at three local coordinates, structural errors, source tampering, receipt tampering, and an optimized read-only source export without Git. The selected-record check and whitespace check pass. Hosted CI is not claimed.

Deterministic receipt SHA256: `1a343f661c9a47c9a5aa5ad5a4308c9f56d10c5a1934542bb5e6cbf889c8ad71`. Sources and CI invalidation inputs are explicit; regeneration uses temporary directories and compares decompressed payloads.

Prepared for Hanson Sun (@bbMisk) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in analysis, implementation, validation and writing. No independent human review is claimed.

## Open next questions

The README and `TASK.json` identify two remaining connections: an explicit Lean event translation for this local certificate, and helper450's actual T16 physical invocations. The first is blocked on the serialization correspondence; the second on chart/route, compiled-recipe and footprint evidence beyond this audit.
